ELPAC Level 2

DTR · TALK ABOUT A SCENE

Three Strings, One Night

STS-HS10-L2-13001400-HSELA910-PCI-NAV-01 • HS English 9–10 • Narrative Techniques and Multiple Plot Lines
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
Booth Tapes is recorded in diners because a diner is where three different conversations happen at three different tables on the same night, and none of the people know they are in the same story. Rosalie's draft is built that way on purpose: one plot line leaves, one waits, one works the last shift, and all three arrive at the same booth by midnight. The teacher is clipping up the third line before anybody has decided whether it earns its place.
If Rosalie cut the third plot line, what would the other two lines have to do differently for the ending to still land?
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
1
What is Maya doing?
Look at the picture. Describe what Maya is doing at the board in one complete sentence. Use exact words for her action and the word she is showing.
2
What is Desmond holding?
Look at the picture. Describe what Desmond has in his hand in one complete sentence. Use exact words for the object in his hand.
3
What is the teacher doing?
Look at the picture. Describe what the teacher is doing with her hands in one complete sentence. Use exact words for her action and the object in her hands.
4
What place is this? How do you know?
Look at the picture. Describe this place and one thing that shows it in one complete sentence. Use exact words for the features you are using as proof.
5
Tell me about the cards on the wall.
Look at the picture. Describe the cards on the wall in one complete sentence. Use exact words for how the cards are hung and what is written on them.
6
What is Rosalie wearing?
Look at the picture. Describe what Rosalie is wearing in one complete sentence. Use exact words for the color and the kind of clothing.
Record an answer for each question, then submit.
Content alignment: CCSS.ELA-LITERACY.W.9-10.3.b — Narrative techniques: dialogue, pacing, description, reflection, and multiple plot lines. ELD (Speaking — official ELPAC “Talk About a Scene”): PI.A.1, PII.B.3, PII.B.4, PII.B.5.
